_comment: The example baskets, and the only place their fund codes are written.
Read by lib/sample.ts to fill the form, and by src/scenarios.py so the
weekly job can re-measure every `expect` against live prices. Two
copies of these codes would drift, and the drift would be invisible:
the job would keep confirming buckets for a basket the page no longer
The Turkish wording is NOT here. It lives in lib/sample.ts, because it
is display text and the backend never handles display text.
`expect` is the mainFinding tier this basket last produced, and the
weekly job's scenario check is what keeps it honest. When it stops
holding, change the funds and re-measure. Never reword to fit.
Twenty baskets, measured through the live /analyze on 2026-09-26 over
the full five years: six notable, six dominant, six none, one minor,
one single. None had a fund excluded, and grouped weights sit clear of
the 0,25 and 0,50 tier lines so a rounding step cannot flip a tier.
